| 2026-03-18 | phase4 | **Phase 4.48: add SlidingWindowAttention, ResidualLinearAttention + config/README sync** — (1) `src/models/attention/sliding_window_attention.py`: `SlidingWindowAttention` — causal attention restricted to a band of `window_size` preceding tokens; Flash Attention 2 backend uses native `window_size=(W-1, 0)` param; standard/fallback backend builds a band-diagonal causal mask via `F.scaled_dot_product_attention`; GQA/MQA + RoPE + ALiBi all supported.
